note: Milestone 70: section completion -- each filing's { checks, incomplete } map and its progress -- for every fixture and variant tests/unit/completion-parity.spec.js builds, all nine filing identities. Recorded in 70L from the frozen copy of legacy-app.js's computeNavChecks() and getWardProgress() as they stood before 70D moved them (which that spec had evaluated beside the new evaluators, and found equal on every one); `results` holds each distinct outcome once, `types` each variant's label and outcome. Regenerate only for a deliberate, recorded change: PG_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 npx vitest run tests/unit/completion-parity.spec.js, and say why here. Changed by Milestone 71B (2026-09-29, attorney optional when none is entered): the Annual family's a-p5 and the Simplified s-p5 are complete with no attorney started (s-cover and s-p6 likewise stop requiring one), a-p10 requires the certifying guardian when co-guardians and no attorney, and the Minor Plan's pm-p7 follows validatePlanMinor(): each of preparer and attorney optional until started, then name plus a valid signature (the saturated variants, whose signature fields hold the literal Yes, now read incomplete there, as the validator reads them). New variants cover the fields 71B added. Changed by Milestone 71C (2026-09-29, a share is a percentage from 0 to 100): the D-1 to D-5 marks and Part VIII (a-p8) also need every share in range or blank, as validateAnnual() now says; the variants whose trust row is filled with the literal Yes (every saturated variant, and the two 'trusts one full row' ones) read Part VIII incomplete for that reason. Changed by Milestone 72B (2026-10-02, the attorney's emails on every form; a blank Inventory share reported): new variants only, for the email keys the models gained; no existing outcome changed. Among them, clearing the Inventory attorney's primary email in a valid filing leaves D-2 incomplete, as validateGuardian() now says; the browser suite's Inventory overlay (tests/e2e/support/fixtures.ts) names its attorney's email. Changed by Milestone 72C (2026-10-02, a guardian's email is a warning on every form; one 'attorney started' test per Plan; the attorney's name required once started): clearing the Simplified guardian's email leaves Part IV (s-p4) complete, as validateSimplified() no longer asks for it; clearing the attorney's name in an Annual, Final or Trust Accounting with an attorney leaves Part V (a-p5) incomplete, as validateAnnual() now requires it; on the Annual Plan and the Plan for Minors any one attorney field on its own starts an attorney, so the signature page (pa-p11, pm-p7) is incomplete until the attorney's name, email and signature are complete, and reads as begun rather than untouched; the Plan for Minors' attorney needs an email (a name alone used to complete pm-p7). New variants cover the Inventory's and Initial Plan's guardian email and the Simplified Plan's certSignerMigrated marker; none changes an outcome. Changed by Milestone 72H (2026-10-02, the certificate's attorney is the filing's): clearing the attorney's name, Florida Bar number, phone or address typed on D-5 no longer leaves D-5 incomplete -- D-5 no longer asks for them, D-2 does. New variants cover certAttorneyMigrated on the Inventory and the Simplified; none changes an outcome. Changed by Milestone 72G (2026-10-02, the method of service and the ward's status kept apart): clearing the Simplified's method (certIndicator) no longer leaves Part VI (s-p6) incomplete -- a missing method warns and never blocks; the ward's status (certWardStatus) is required on Part VI and on the Annual family's Part X (a-p10), and the browser suite's Annual and Simplified overlays (tests/e2e/support/fixtures.ts) answer it. New variants cover certWardStatus, certIndicatorMigrated and the Inventory's serviceMethod; no other outcome changed. Changed by Milestone 73A (2026-10-06, a guardian signs by hand or by stamp; each year's data carries signaturePolicy, 2 on every new filing): a guardian's signature counts on the Annual family's Part III (a-p3), the Simplified's Part IV (s-p4), the Annual Plan's signature page (pa-p11), the Initial Plan's (pi-p9) and the Plan for Minors' (pm-p6) only when the export check accepts it -- the saturated filings' unreadable choice, which every validator already refused, leaves those pages incomplete where a typed date used to complete them (on the Annual family a second guardian's too); a guardian's blank choice is Unsigned and complete without a date, so the Annual Plan's and the Simplified Plan's first guardian with only a name, or with the date cleared, no longer leaves pa-p11 or ps-p3 incomplete. New variants clear signaturePolicy (the legacy rule); each returns what its sibling does. Changed by Milestone 73F part 2 (2026-10-06, one answer to "is this section complete?"), in two steps checked separately. First the variant generator (tests/unit/support/filing-variants.js) stopped writing 'Yes' into signature-choice fields -- a saturated filing's blocks take Unsigned -- and gained a '"/s/" undated' and a 'stamp without image' variant for each signature block: 70 new variants, and only variants built from the saturated filing changed. Then the marks moved to the export checks (src/core/status/section-marks.js) and the per-type rules in completion.js retired. A page now shows - where export blocks: a blank Amended Form? (the Annual family's Part I); Part X's attorney signature undated "/s/", a stamp without its image or an unreadable choice (a-p10); Part IV's preparer and Part V's attorney with a stamp without its image or an unreadable choice (a-p4, a-p5), and the Initial Plan's attorney likewise (pi-p10); a started Part XI line under a ticked "no items" box (a-p11); Part VIII's trusts question unanswered beside a named trust or the tick (a-p8); the Annual and Simplified Plans' guardian phone, address or SSN (pa-p11, ps-p3). And ✓ where export passes: a preparer's or attorney's Unsigned block without a date (a-p4, a-p5, pi-p10); Part VIII answered without the extra tick or a named trust (73F-5, decided); an emptied guardian list (a-p3, s-p4 -- not reachable through the pages, which keep one card, and the Cover still asks for the guardian); a Simplified Part VII row holding only a key no remuneration row has (s-p7). The Initial Inventory's marks are unchanged (they were already its export check's). "Begun" (the Summary pages' "in progress") is unchanged and reads begun only while incomplete, so it follows those marks. The marks' key order follows the sidebar. Changed by Milestone 74B (2026-10-06): a started Plan co-guardian is checked like the first guardian, so the Annual Plan's Signatures page (pa-p11) is unfinished when a co-guardian's name, mailing street, phone or SSN is cleared (8 variants); nothing else moves. Changed by Milestone 73G part 1 (2026-10-06): an amount holding text that is not an amount is named by the export checks (field.amount.unreadable), so a page holding the variant builder's placeholder text in an amount is unfinished: 400 variants, every one a page going from complete to unfinished and nothing else -- the Annual Plan's Q11 page (pa-p10, q11Amount "Yes": 388), Schedule A (a-scha, a row of "x": 6), Part VIII (a-p8, the trust's wardAmount "Yes": 3) and Part II (a-p2, startingBalance "Yes": 3), across the Annual, Final and Trust Accountings. Changed by Milestone 73F part 3 (2026-10-06): the Inventory's Cover is unfinished without "Amended Form?" (one variant: the minimal valid Inventory now answers it, so its variant "valid: amendedForm answered" is now "valid: amendedForm cleared"); the variant builder now answers amounts with numbers and the county with a Florida county, so the placeholder-text amounts 73G part 1 recorded above are gone -- the Annual Plan's Q11 (388), Schedule A (6), Part VIII (3) and Part II (3) are complete again -- and three Annual-family "startingBalance answered" variants mark Parts VI & VII unfinished (the reconciliation). Nothing else moved. Changed by Milestone 73B (2026-10-07): the Annual, Final and Trust Accounting require Part I's Type of Guardianship, so clearing it leaves Part I unfinished (each identity's saturated and valid variants); the valid Annual fixture now states a Type of Guardianship and a relationship, so two variant names swap answered and cleared. No result changed. Regenerated by Milestone 74P (2026-10-07) for its new variants only: the 'same as' boxes (guardians[].officeSameAsMailing, planGuardians[].officeSameAsMailing, mailingSameAsResidence) are new fields, so the variants that clear, set or isolate them were added (21); no existing variant's result changed. Changed by Milestone 73O part 2 (2026-10-08): every certificate recipient is a name and four address lines, so the Inventory's address/cityStateZip variants (8) gave way to line2-line5 variants and the new lines added theirs (55 in all); a listed Inventory recipient needs only a name (decision 73O-N3), so 'valid: serviceRecipients[0] only name' now completes D-5. Nothing else changed. Regenerated for TEST-REVIEW.md Delivery 3's fixtures (2026-10-15, after Delivery 5's CI run found the goldens stale): the Plan Simplified, the Plan for Minors and the Initial Plan gained minimal valid overlays in tests/e2e/support/fixtures.ts (ed53d32, 2026-10-14), so each gains a "minimal valid" variant and its "valid: ..." family (491 variants in all), and their saturated filing is now built from the overlay rather than the blank filing, so every "saturated ..." variant of those three types is a different filing than before (518 outcomes changed, one label gone, the Initial Plan's leaf order follows the overlay's rows). No engine changed: nothing under src/ changed between the last green run (db8e1f5, 2026-10-14) and this one, and the other six types' variants are identical. Regenerated for TEST-REVIEW.md Delivery 6 item 1 (2026-10-15): the Plan for Minors' minimal valid overlay no longer carries caseNumber, a field that form does not have (it keeps its Case # in ref), so its two variants that cleared it are gone; the fixture contract now refuses a key a form lacks. No outcome changed. Regenerated for Milestone 74I (2026-10-16): a witness card the filer started needs its name, address and occupation (decision 74I-1), so the Inventory's variants that fill a witness's name alone now also ask for the address and the occupation; nothing else changed. Regenerated for Milestone 74N (2026-10-16): the Annual, Final and Trust Accountings carry a trustInfo block (variants that toggle its fields are new), a Trust Accounting asks for its trust's name (decision 74N-1), and its minimal valid filing names one; nothing else changed. Regenerated for Milestone 74J-2 (2026-10-16): a Final Accounting has a Final Report page (Rule 5.680(c), decision 74J-N1), so every Final variant's map gains a-final -- unfinished, since no variant answers its two lists -- and its progress counts 25 sections where it counted 24; nothing else changed. Regenerated 2026-10-20 for Milestone 76J item 2 (224b8d7b, which missed it): Part VIII's ward share is checked only under a Yes, so the Annual-family variants built on the saturated filing -- which answers Part VIII No with an unreadable share in the hidden box -- now mark Part VIII complete (870 outcomes, one more section complete each); nothing else changed. Regenerated for Milestone 77C (2026-10-20, dates left for whoever serves and files): a blank Certificate of Service date (the Inventory, the Annual, Final and Trust Accountings, the Simplified) and the Inventory’s blank attorney Filing Date are no longer listed, so the 13 variants whose only gap was one of them now mark that page complete (the Inventory’s D-2 and D-5, the Simplified’s Part VI, each Annual-family type’s Part X); nothing else changed.
